$schema.description: URL or relative path to the timesheet schema

project.description: Name of the project being tracked

client.description: Customer or client name for whom the work is performed

currency.description: Currency code (e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, CAD)

hourlyRate.description: Hourly billing rate for this project

notes.description: General billing or project notes for the customer

id.description: Unique identifier for this time entry

date.description: Date of the work in YYYY-MM-DD format

durationHours.description: Duration spent in decimal hours (e.g., 1.5 = 1 hr 30 mins)

category.description: Task category or tag (e.g. Development, Code Review, Meeting, Bugfix)

description.description: Detailed description of what work was completed

billable.description: Whether this entry should be billed to the customer

invoiced.description: Whether this entry has already been included on a sent invoice

invoiceNumber.description: Optional invoice ID or reference number if invoiced
